name: Sukiyabashi Jiro Roppongi
description: Legendary omakase experience. Intimate 10-seat counter with master sushi chef. Each piece is a work of art crafted from the finest seasonal fish.
booking_note: Reserve 1 month in advance, formal dress code

name: Gonpachi Nishi-Azabu
description: The iconic 'Kill Bill' restaurant with dramatic wooden interiors across multiple floors. Excellent soba noodles, yakitori, and tempura in a theatrical setting.

name: Gion Maruyama
description: Exquisite multi-course kaiseki in a historic Gion machiya. Seasonal ingredients presented as edible art, each course telling a story of Kyoto's culinary heritage.

name: Soneva Fushi Out of the Blue
description: Overwater fine dining under the stars. A private table on the ocean with a bespoke 7-course menu crafted by the resort's Michelin-starred chef. Barefoot luxury at its finest.
booking_note: Reserve on arrival, available 3 nights per week

name: 1135 AD
description: Royal Rajasthani cuisine in a palatial setting at the foot of Amber Fort. Signature laal maas and dal baati churma served with traditional live folk performances.
booking_note: Book dinner with folk show for best experience

name: Ambrai Restaurant
description: Lakeside dining with unobstructed views of City Palace and Lake Palace lit up at night. The setting alone makes this one of India's most romantic restaurants.
booking_note: Request lakeside table, reserve 2 days ahead

name: Locavore
description: Asia's Top 50 restaurant serving hyper-local tasting menus using only Indonesian ingredients. A culinary journey through the archipelago's terroir.
booking_note: Book 2 weeks in advance, tasting menu only

name: Sardarni Saheb
description: Hidden gem in the Blue City serving authentic Marwari vegetarian thali with panoramic fort views from the rooftop. Charming heritage ambiance.

name: Kappo Takamura
description: An intimate 8-seat kappo counter where the chef prepares seasonal Osaka cuisine before your eyes. Multi-course omakase with premium sake pairings. A hidden gem of Namba's culinary scene.
booking_note: Concierge booking only, reserve 1 week ahead

name: Mizuno Okonomiyaki
description: Osaka's most celebrated okonomiyaki since 1945. Watch masters flip the signature yamaimo-yaki on the teppan griddle while you sit at the counter. An essential Osaka culinary experience.

name: Sarong Restaurant
description: Award-winning pan-Asian fine dining in a lush tropical garden. Signature dishes blend Indonesian, Indian, and Middle Eastern flavors. The candlelit setting under frangipani trees is pure romance.
booking_note: Reserve 3 days ahead, garden table recommended

name: Shades of Green
description: Soneva Fushi's garden-to-table restaurant nestled in the organic gardens. Every ingredient is grown steps away. The tasting menu celebrates Maldivian and South Asian flavors with zero food miles.
booking_note: Open daily for lunch, reserve morning of

name: Peacock Rooftop
description: Rooftop dining with panoramic views of the illuminated Hawa Mahal and Jaipur skyline. Modern twists on traditional Rajasthani cuisine with live folk music. A magical evening atmosphere.
booking_note: Request rooftop table with Hawa Mahal view
